text:
jess: heads up — HelioTech (acct HT-442) says the reissued invoice for INV-9876 is missing their PO number. They need the reissued PDF to include PO for AP, otherwise payment is blocked. customer-sent screenshot: https://files.redwood/helio/inv-9876-snap.png

omar: thanks. can you paste the original invoice id + the reissue id? also did they request a credit-first reissue or an edit->reissue flow?

jess: original INV-9876, reissued created by our portal as INV-9876-R1 (customer-facing). They requested a credit then reissue (we issued credit CR-332 and generated reissue). On portal the original shows PO: PO-5544, but PDF for INV-9876-R1 has no PO line.

lee: quick guess: reissue path doesn't copy purchase_order when invoice is generated from a credit. saw similar in a sandbox once. @marta FYI for VAT/tax implications if we reissue without PO in EU customers.

marta: noted. if PO drops we might also lose cross-check on VAT reports for that invoice. need a fix or a manual patch for this customer asap.

omar: I pulled logs for invoice workflow: billing-service v2 at 2026-03-16T19:02:11Z shows: 
```
INFO ReissueRequest(id=INV-9876, via=credit, src_cr=CR-332)
DEBUG copy_fields: ["line_items","meta","notes"]
WARN purchase_order not in copy_fields
```
Response payload for generated invoice: 
```
{
  "id": "INV-9876-R1",
  "amount": 34250,
  "currency": "USD",
  "lines": [...],
  "meta": {"created_by": "portal"}
}
```
no purchase_order key.

jess: customer on enterprise plan, needs fix today. AP cut-off in EU is tomorrow morning.

lee: workaround: we can PATCH the reissued invoice to add purchase_order and regenerate PDF. API: 
```
PATCH /v1/invoices/INV-9876-R1
payload { "purchase_order": "PO-5544" }
POST /v1/invoices/INV-9876-R1/regenerate_pdf
```
I'll do if support confirms we should.

omar: confirm we can safely patch without breaking ledger references? Finance: @lee will this change require new credit or reconciliation?

lee: patching purchase_order on reissued invoice is metadata-only and won't change amounts or ledger ids. Safe. We'll regenerate PDF and upload to S3. I can do it and send the new link.

marta: please confirm VAT rounding/summary still matches after regenerate. If PDF template pulls PO from metadata it should be identical.

jess: please proceed. customer is OK with manual patch if we provide final PDF and a short explanation. cc: support case SC-2241.

billing-bot: created task BI-4321 for engineering to add purchase_order to default copy_fields in reissue-from-credit flow (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BI-4321). Priority: P2.

lee: patched INV-9876-R1 with PO-5544, regenerated PDF, uploaded: https://files.redwood/helio/inv-9876-r1-patched.pdf. sent to customer via portal and emailed contact.

jess: customer confirmed they received the PDF and AP accepted it. closing ticket after final bookkeeping check. thanks everyone. :tada:

omar: engineering follow-up: will add automated unit test to cover purchase_order retention and a quick rollout to hosted tomorrow morning.

lee: leaving this thread open until BI-4321 is merged and deployed.

jess: marking as resolved for support side, will re-open if anything else pops up.
